fields.static_scene: A medium street with muddy cobblestone surfaces and embedded metal tram tracks. Red brick buildings line the right, while wooden frontier-style buildings and telegraph poles are visible in the distance.
fields.subject_motion: The character walks steadily forward down a muddy cobblestone street toward an intersection, passing pedestrians on the right.
fields.environment_motion: A white horse-drawn carriage enters from the left and moves parallel to the character, eventually passing them on the left side.
fields.camera_description: A stabilized third-person follow camera at chest height, moving forward in a straight line.

fields.static_scene: A corner intersection featuring a grand three-story stone building with wrought iron balconies, decorative cornices, and an American flag mounted on the facade.
fields.subject_motion: The character turns left at the intersection and walks alongside a large ornate building, keeping pace with a carriage.
fields.environment_motion: A horse-drawn carriage moves parallel to the character along the new street. Pedestrians walk in the opposing direction.
fields.camera_description: A stabilized third-person follow camera at chest height, executing a left turn to follow the character's path.

fields.static_scene: A historic commercial street with continuous wrought iron balconies on the left and ornate black street lamps on the right sidewalk. Tram tracks lead forward into the hazy light.
fields.subject_motion: The character continues walking forward, following behind the carriage as it pulls away.
fields.environment_motion: The horse-drawn carriage transitions from moving alongside the character to leading them, moving further into the distance.
fields.camera_description: A stabilized third-person follow camera at chest height, moving forward in a straight line.

trajectory.convention: OpenCV camera-to-world; translated to the first sample and normalized by the largest axis span.
trajectory.alignment_status: Pose sample n corresponds to original source frame n × source_frame_stride, with the first frame as time zero.
